text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's finally almost my turn. This long line is finally coming to an end...!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry, customer.
We are completely sold out for today...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my goooood!
My airline bento~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl was disappointed that she couldn't buy the bento box she had been looking forward to.
